correction: Add AC to STORY-01-007 mandating Dockerfile.airflow chown /opt/patient_360 to airflow:root before USER switch; retrofit for LLD-DEVIATIONS row 7
pattern: When a foundation story produces a Dockerfile that hosts a project root which the airflow uid (50000) must write to at runtime, the story MUST carry an explicit AC requiring a USER root mkdir+chown+chmod block before the final USER airflow directive — Docker auto-creates bind-mount parents as root and the writability is otherwise unverifiable.
